oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Integrated pest management.
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Tweedy, B G
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: Research Article
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Integrated pest management, in which the conventional pesticides are augmented by one or more nonchemical control practices, has been receiving renewed interest. What is new in this revitalization of an old technique is the careful and more knowledgeable application of a variety of control techniques.
